## No.1 [DENIED] Standalone GitTui with XML view and portable Git model

Use the Tools best-practice library/application organization and existing MSBuild configurations. Author view-model contracts and all UI event handlers in XML, generate embedded C++ resources with the supplied GacBuild, and implement repository behavior in C++. Run Git with argument vectors rather than shell interpolation, preserve NUL-separated UTF-8 output, and disable optional index writes for read operations. Branch selection changes only the history reference; CHANGES always describes the working tree. Pull actions apply only to the checked-out branch. The rebase action first attempts an ordinary pull, aborts only a merge conflict created by that attempt, then retries with rebase; unresolved conflicts remain for external resolution. No watchers or GUI executable.

### CODE CHANGE

Added GitView.sln with Gaclib, GitView, GitTui and GitViewTests projects for Debug/Release and Win32/x64. Gaclib compiles imports, released GacUI and TuiSkin. GitView/UI contains all contracts, bindings, layouts and event handlers; its Source folder is genuine GacBuild output with compressed embedded resources. GitView/Model implements argument-vector process execution, NUL-preserving UTF-8 decoding, repository discovery, change/history parsing, first-parent merge diffs and explicit pull operations. GitView/ViewModel supplies branch, tree, list, status and selection state. GitTui registers TuiSkin and selects the platform renderer. Added README build/use instructions and authored vmake configuration pointing to native Unix TUI providers; vmake remains unexecuted with no makefile or vmake.txt produced. Tools/GitView/AGENTS.md is unchanged.

Real-repository tests exposed and fixed NUL truncation in UTF-8 conversion, quoted attrib switches during Windows fixture cleanup, merge file lists comparing against both parents, and ambiguous short branch names when a same-named tag exists. Terminal interaction exposed and fixed missing combo display text and status autoscrolling; XML changes were regenerated by GacBuild. Per-file /bigobj is used for the large GacUI, Windows provider and TuiSkin translation units; ordinary application files do not need it.

## No.2 [CONFIRMED] Compact terminal layout and parsed, numbered source diffs

Follow GacUILayout.md's terminal best practices with zero outer layout padding and only the one-cell horizontal gaps needed for draggable splitters. Disable always-visible scrollbars in every list/tree and multiline textbox, including the branch popup. Parse zero-context unified hunks into source rows, reading the index blob for staged files, the selected commit blob for history and the current file for working-tree changes. Render only deleted/added source lines and up to three surrounding unchanged lines, merging overlapping context windows without duplicates. Use old line numbers for deletions and new numbers for additions/context, minimum width four followed by one space; retain real blank lines and numbers above 9999. Show friendly binary/submodule/metadata summaries instead of patch syntax. Split commit subject/author from hash/time and retain commit details in the status area when selecting a history file.

### CODE CHANGE

Update the Git model, view model, XML and focused regression tests; regenerate C++ through GacBuild. Verify adjacent/overlapping and separated hunks, additions/deletions, missing final newline, leading patch-like source text, staged versus working-tree versus historical contents, binary files, source number formatting and commit details. Build and run GitViewTests through wrappers, run the required existing GacUI unit suite, and inspect the actual terminal replay for spacing, scrollbars, source rows, colors, history details and scrolling. Keep AGENTS.md and vmake unchanged; do not execute vmake or fabricate its outputs.

Reserve three content rows plus its two border rows. Reset caret and view position when status changes so long wrapped messages start at the beginning.

Use an ordinary zero-context comparison against the index's ours stage for conflicted working files, so conflicts also produce source rows rather than combined-diff syntax. Preserve UTF-8 BOMs while matching working-file content against Git's patch. Tests additionally cover working/index/committed deletions and untracked binary/BOM files. Correct API usage discovered by compiling: List enumeration is readonly, and ReadAllTextWithEncodingTesting requires encoding and BOM outputs.

The added binary-file fixture initially used the text encoder, which omitted its NUL and produced a text file. Direct Git output and a byte dump confirmed the fixture error. Write its binary bytes through FileStream instead; the rendering implementation needs no change for this failure.

All three splitters resized their panes, the diff responded to wheel scrolling, empty panes hid scrollbars, and both sessions exited normally through ACTIONS. This checks pseudoconsole input/output, not physical desktop input or displayed terminal appearance.
